senses.gloss: अर्भक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Small, little; 2. weak; 3. young, childish (rarely used in classics as an adjective).
अर्भक (II) m. 1. A boy, a child, श्रुतस्य यायादयमन्तमर्भकः R.iii.21, 25, vii.67; 2. a fool, an idiot.
